zh.title: 视觉小说模式
zh.text:
点顶栏的「视觉小说」，最新一条回复就变成游戏画面：场景做背景，说话的人站在前面，名字栏、打字机，一句一句往下读。
开关按角色卡记住；发给模型的内容一字不改，缓存不受影响。

en.title: Visual novel mode
en.text:
Switch on Visual novel in the top bar and the latest reply plays like a game: the scene behind, whoever speaks in front, a name plate and typewriter text, one line at a time.
Remembered per card; what the model is sent never changes, so the cache is untouched.

zh.title: 每个人都有立绘
zh.text:
谁说话谁站出来，旁白时退下。配图名单里白底的人设图自动抠图、描白边；没有能用的就按长相画一张半身立绘。
说话人自动认出来——连「她说」「掌柜的愣了一下」这种也认得；名字栏按人分颜色，对白和旁白分开上色。

en.title: A sprite for everyone
en.text:
Whoever speaks steps forward; during narration they step back. White-background reference pictures in the cast list are cut out and outlined; anyone without one gets a half-body sprite drawn from their looks.
Speakers are told even from "she said" or a nameless innkeeper; each name plate has its own colour, and dialogue is coloured apart from narration.

zh.title: 场景图
zh.text:
故事到了新地点，自动画一张没有人物的场景当背景，存在这张卡下面，下次到同一个地方直接用。也可以「画这一轮的场景」，按这一轮写的样子画。
傍晚、夜里、雨、雪用色调和动画表现，不用重画。

en.title: Scenes
en.text:
When the story reaches a new place, an empty scene is drawn for it as the background, kept with the card and reused whenever the story returns. Or draw this turn's scene, as the reply describes it.
Dusk, night, rain and snow are tints and animations over it, not new pictures.

zh.title: 像游戏一样选
zh.text:
读到最后，行动选项在画面中央弹出来，按 1–4 直接选，✎ 先改再发，也可以自己写。
还有回看、自动、跳过、全屏（F）、逐句朗读，一条回复中途换地点时背景也跟着换。

en.title: Choose like in a game
en.text:
At the end of a reply the choices open in the middle of the picture: press 1–4 to pick, ✎ to edit one first, or write your own.
Also: backlog, auto, skip, full screen (F), line-by-line reading, and the background follows the story when it moves on halfway through a reply.

zh.title: 导入 SillyTavern 的对话
zh.text:
把 SillyTavern 的对话记录（.jsonl）拖进窗口，或者在角色卡下点「导入存档」：每一轮、每个 swipe、MVU 变量都带过来。
很长的对话可以先压缩成剧情存档，之后只发存档和最近两轮，原文都还在。

en.title: Import SillyTavern chats
en.text:
Drop a SillyTavern chat (.jsonl) into the window, or use Import archive under a card: every turn, every swipe and the MVU variables come with it.
A long one can be compacted into a story archive first, so each turn sends only the archive and the last two turns; the full text stays.

zh.title: 手机添加到主屏幕
zh.text:
开着「手机访问」时，iPhone 用 Safari、安卓用 Chrome 打开链接，添加到主屏幕后像 App 一样全屏打开，不用再输口令。
朗读的控制条也变成了输入框上方的小胶囊，不再挡住输入框。

en.title: On your phone's home screen
en.text:
With phone access on, open the link in Safari (iPhone) or Chrome (Android) and add it to the home screen: it opens full screen like an app, no key to type again.
The read-aloud controls are now a small pill above the input instead of a bar over it.

zh.title: 每个角色有自己的音色
zh.text:
在「配图与朗读 → 朗读 → 音色」里，给角色名册里的每个人选一个音色，没选的用对白音色。
视觉小说模式按每句的说话人读；普通模式点「朗读」或点一句对白也一样，两个人挨着说的话不再连成一段。

en.title: A voice for each character
en.text:
In Pictures & voice → Voice → Voices, give everyone in the cast a voice of their own; anyone without one takes the dialogue voice.
Visual novel mode reads each line in its speaker's voice, and so do Read aloud and clicking a line; two people's lines next to each other are no longer read as one.

zh.title: 视觉小说里直接改设置
zh.text:
右上角「朗读」「配图」旁边的 ▾：逐句朗读、自动翻页、各人的音色、朗读模型；新回复自动配图、场景和立绘怎么画、画图方式和模型、画幅。
改了马上保存，「更多…」打开完整的设置。

en.title: Settings right in the visual novel
en.text:
The ▾ beside Read and Pictures at the top right: line-by-line reading, auto-advance, everyone's voice and the voice model; pictures for new replies, how scenes and sprites are drawn, the image backend, model and shape.
Changes save at once; More… opens the full settings.

zh.title: CG 回廊
zh.text:
右上角「CG」或按 G：这条故事线上所有的配图，标着是开场还是第几轮。
点一张全屏看，← → 翻遍所有 CG，Esc 回到回廊。

en.title: CG gallery
en.text:
CG at the top right, or G: every picture on this storyline, each marked with its turn.
Open one full size, ← → go through all of them, Esc goes back to the gallery.

zh.title: 更多画图方式和音色
zh.text:
新增 Gemini 原生生图（Nano Banana，能照人设图画）、本地的 SD WebUI / Forge，OpenRouter 的出图模型也能用了；朗读多了 Gemini 的 30 个音色。Gemini 用「Gemini」模板建的供应商，和对话共用密钥。
还没设好的画图方式和朗读来源，会在「配图与朗读」里标出来。

en.title: More ways to draw and to speak
en.text:
New: Gemini's own image models (Nano Banana, following reference pictures), local SD WebUI / Forge, and OpenRouter's image models; Gemini's 30 voices for reading aloud. Gemini uses the provider made from the Gemini template, the same key as chat.
An image backend or voice source that isn't set up yet now stands out in Pictures & voice.

zh.title: 名字栏更准
zh.text:
冒号前的叙述（「嘴角翘起来：」「笑得很短：」）不再被当成人名，「柏木绾追问」「顾言如实说」这类认得出名字；刚打开一张卡时，第一句的名字栏也不会错。
另外修了：视觉小说里选完选项后，输入框只剩一条缝。

en.title: Sharper name plates
en.text:
Narration before a colon is no longer taken for a name, and more ways of naming who speaks are understood; the first line's plate is right when a card has just opened.
Also fixed: the input box shrinking to a sliver after a choice in visual novel mode.

zh.title: 世界书条目可以查看和修改
zh.text:
设置 →「挂载的世界书」→「查看条目」：卡里自带的和导入的世界书逐条列出，可以搜索、开关，改名字、触发方式、关键词、位置、顺序和内容，改了自动保存。
常驻条目写在对话开局的固定前缀里，进行中的对话要「应用到当前对话」才会用上；关键词条目下一轮就生效。

en.title: View and edit lorebook entries
en.text:
Settings → Attached lorebooks → View entries: a card's own lorebook and the imported ones, entry by entry. Search them, switch them on or off, and edit the name, trigger, keywords, position, order and text; changes save at once.
Always-on entries live in the fixed prefix written when a chat starts, so a chat under way picks them up after Apply to this chat; keyword entries take effect on the next turn.

zh.title: 手机上的视觉小说
zh.text:
右上角只留一行按钮，其余收进「⋯」；「朗读」「配图」旁的 ▾ 从屏幕底部弹出，人多也能滚到底。
选项排在控制栏和文本框之间，长选项也能完整显示；手机横过来时，左边的角色卡栏收起。

en.title: Visual novel mode on phones
en.text:
One row of buttons at the top right, the rest behind ⋯; the ▾ beside Read and Pictures opens as a sheet from the bottom that scrolls however long the cast is.
The choices fit between the buttons and the text box, long ones included; held sideways, the card list steps aside.

zh.title: 名字栏更准
zh.text:
角色名册没写性别时，也能从回复里推断「他」「她」是谁；两人一来一回说话时，单独一句引号认得出是谁说的；「他听见她说」归给「她」。
另外，设置里的「配图与朗读」单独成了一组，不用再去「更多」里找。

en.title: Sharper name plates
en.text:
With no genders in the cast list, "he" and "she" are worked out from the reply; when two people trade lines, a lone quote goes to the right one; "he heard her say" goes to her.
Also: Pictures & voice is a group of its own in Settings instead of a row under More.

zh.title: 修改角色卡
zh.text:
角色卡的「⋯ → 修改角色卡」：名字、描述、开场白、世界书这些都能直接改，改了存进这张卡，对话和名册都不变。
也可以在右边用对话修改：说说想怎么改，模型把每一处改前改后标出来，勾选的才会用上。

en.title: Edit a card
en.text:
A card's ⋯ → Edit card: change the name, description, greetings, lorebook and the rest in place; it saves into the card, and its chats and cast stay as they are.
Or edit by chat on the right: say what to change, and each change is shown before and after, applied only if ticked.

zh.title: 生成头像，每次画图都能选方式
zh.text:
修改角色卡里点「生成头像」，按卡里的角色画一张方形头像，满意了再换上。
生成头像、名册的「画一张」、配图的「重画」和「换个画法…」都能临时选这一张用哪种画图方式和模型，不改设置。

en.title: Generate an avatar, pick how each picture is drawn
en.text:
In Edit card, Generate avatar draws a square avatar of the card's character, put on only when you take it.
Generate avatar, the cast's Draw one, and Redraw or Draw it differently… under a picture can each pick the image backend and model for that one picture, without changing your settings.

zh.title: 手机上的应用内更新
zh.text:
设置 → 更多 → 更新 →「下载并安装」：在应用里下载，断网了接着下；核对 SHA-256 和签名后直接打开系统的安装界面，点「更新」就好，数据保留。
第一次会先打开「安装未知应用」的设置，打开开关后返回会接着安装。

en.title: In-app updates on the phone
en.text:
Settings → More → Updates → Download and install: the app downloads it, picking up where a dropped connection left off, checks the SHA-256 and signature, then opens the system installer; tap Update and your data stays.
The first time, it opens the Install unknown apps setting: turn it on and come back, and the install carries on.

zh.title: 视觉小说：多人同屏、表情和演出
zh.text:
场景里说话的人一起站在台上（电脑最多三个，手机两个），说话的亮起，其余的暗下去；叙述里写了离开或者换了地点就退场。
「立绘」窗口里可以给每个角色画一套表情，每句按叙述换；闪电、巨响时画面闪白或震动。

en.title: Visual novel: several on stage, expressions and effects
en.text:
The people in a scene stand on stage together (up to three on a computer, two on a phone): the speaker lit, the rest dimmed, stepping off when the narration has them leave or the place changes.
In the Sprites window each character can get a set of expressions, picked line by line from the narration; lightning or a crash flashes or shakes the picture.

zh.title: 存档和读档
zh.text:
视觉小说模式右上角的「存档」「读档」：每张卡 18 个存档位、一个快速存档（F5 存、F9 读）和每轮自动存的最近十个。
读档回到存档的那一句接着玩，之后写过的收起来保留成分支，不会删掉。

en.title: Save and load
en.text:
Save and Load at the top right of visual novel mode: 18 slots for each card, a quick save (F5 to save, F9 to load) and the last ten turns saved on their own.
Loading picks up at the saved line; whatever was written after it is kept as a branch, not deleted.

zh.title: 世界书管理
zh.text:
角色卡列表上方的「世界书」，或 设置 → 世界书与状态 →「管理世界书」：导入的每本世界书都能改名、写备注、导出、复制、删除，一次勾选挂在哪些卡上，还能单独设扫描深度。
「多选」可以一次启用、停用、删除条目，或者复制、移动到另一本。

en.title: Manage lorebooks
en.text:
Lorebook beside the card list's heading, or Settings → Lorebooks & state → Manage lorebooks: rename, note, export, duplicate or delete each imported lorebook, tick the cards it's attached to in one place, and give it its own scan depth.
Select enables, disables or deletes several entries at once, or copies or moves them to another lorebook.

zh.title: 对话修改：世界书、预设、正则和主题
zh.text:
这四个窗口都有了「对话修改」：说想怎么改，向导把要改的地方整条写出来，改前改后对照着看，勾上的才改进去，刚采用的还能撤销。
空白的世界书说一句想法就写出一整本；正则先拿最新回复试一遍再给你看；主题配好浅色和深色两套，能先在界面上预览。

en.title: Edit by chat: lorebooks, presets, regex and the theme
en.text:
All four windows now have Edit by chat: say what to change, and the guide writes out each piece it would change, before and after side by side; only what you tick goes in, and the last change can be undone.
An empty lorebook can be written from one sentence; regex is tried on the latest reply before you see it; the theme comes as a light and a dark set you can preview on the page first.

zh.title: 自定义配色、字体字号、搜索和全局世界书
zh.text:
「主题」里有了自定义配色（十二个颜色逐个调）和故事正文的字体、字号；角色卡列表和世界书都能搜索，世界书还能设成全局，所有对话都用。
另外，配图里一定会有人物，开场白多的卡也能一条条看清再选。

en.title: Custom colours, font and size, search, global lorebooks
en.text:
Theme now has custom colours (twelve, each adjustable) and the story's font and size; the card list and the lorebooks can be searched, and a lorebook can be made global for every chat.
Also: pictures always have someone in them, and a card with many openings shows each one in full before you pick.

zh.title: 视觉小说模式（1.8 起）
zh.text:
点顶栏的「视觉小说」，回复变成一句一句读的游戏画面：说话的人站上台、带着表情，几个人可以同屏；到了新地点自动画一张场景当背景，配图都收进 CG 回廊；每个角色有自己的音色，还能存档读档。
只改显示，发给模型的内容一字不改。

en.title: Visual novel mode (since 1.8)
en.text:
Turn on "Visual novel" in the top bar and replies play like a game, a line at a time: whoever speaks steps on stage with an expression, several at once; a new place gets a scene drawn behind it, and every picture goes into the CG gallery; each character can have their own voice, and you can save and load.
Only the display changes; what goes to the model stays word for word.

zh.title: 1.8 的其他更新
zh.text:
修改角色卡、生成头像；世界书逐条修改和整本管理；导入 SillyTavern 的对话；手机添加到主屏幕，安卓在应用里下载更新；画图多了 Gemini、SD WebUI 和 OpenRouter。
想看每一版的详细介绍，点上面的「CicaTavern 1.9」换到 1.8。

en.title: More from 1.8
en.text:
Edit a card and generate its avatar; edit lorebook entries and manage whole lorebooks; import SillyTavern chats; add the app to your phone's home screen, and on Android download updates in the app; draw with Gemini, SD WebUI or OpenRouter.
For each version's own pages, pick 1.8 from "CicaTavern 1.9" above.

zh.title: 视觉小说：HUD、换天和回忆
zh.text:
画面左上角常驻几个变量（好感、体力、金钱……点一下选显示哪些，显示成条、数字还是图标）；读到一轮的结尾，下面弹出「好感 +5」「获得：旧信」。
日期往后走时画面中间出现「第 N 天」，回忆的段落画面泛黄。

en.title: Visual novel: a HUD, new days and memories
en.text:
A few variables stay at the top left (affection, stamina, money…; click it to choose which, each as a bar, a number or an icon); at the end of a turn, notes like "Affection +5" and "Got: old letter" pop up under it.
When the date moves on, "Day N" crosses the picture, and memories turn sepia.

zh.title: 补写变量、选项按钮和表情包
zh.text:
MVU 卡的回复漏了变量更新块时，点「补写变量」只补那一块；卡和预设自己的行动选项（「探索选项」「请选择你的下一步行动」这类）也变成能点的按钮。
「立绘」里能导入 SillyTavern 的表情包，「角色名册」能从对话里补上后来出场的角色。

en.title: Write variables, choice buttons and expression packs
en.text:
When an MVU card's reply leaves out its variable update, "Write variables" writes just that block; a card's or preset's own action options become buttons too.
Sprites can import a SillyTavern expression pack, and the cast list can add the characters who joined later, from the chat.

zh.title: 视觉小说：模型标出谁在说话
zh.text:
视觉小说里，模型会在每句台词前标上说话人和表情（标记本身不显示），名字栏、立绘和表情都按标的来，不用再从叙述里猜；遇到冲击、雷电还能标上震屏、闪白。
用基础预设时默认开；用导入的预设时在「立绘 → 对白标注」里打开。只加在每轮的消息里，开关不影响缓存。

en.title: Visual novel: the model marks who is speaking
en.text:
In the visual novel mode the model marks who says each line and how they look (the marks are not shown), so the name plate, the sprite and the expression follow them instead of a guess from the narration; it can also ask for a shake or a flash.
On by default with the built-in preset; with an imported one, turn it on in Sprites → Mark speakers. It rides on each turn's message only, so switching it costs no cache.

zh.title: 国内更新镜像和修复
zh.text:
检查更新时 GitHub 连不上或迟迟不回应，会改从国内镜像（cnb.cool）取版本信息和安装包，带签名校验，从下一次更新起用得上。
修复：回复结尾有一长串 ** 装饰时打开对话会卡住；视觉小说边写边读时会被拉回前面一句、来回循环。

en.title: An update mirror in China, and fixes
en.text:
When GitHub cannot be reached for an update, or takes too long, the app turns to a mirror in China (cnb.cool) for the release and the package, with a signature check; it helps from the next update on.
Fixed: a chat froze when a reply ended on a long run of ** decorations; reading a visual novel reply while it was written kept jumping back to an earlier line.

zh.title: 角色卡里的界面能做更多事
zh.text:
为酒馆助手做的界面（开局页、战斗、小游戏）现在能调用模型（每张卡第一次先问你）、读写世界书（只改这个对话）、保存聊天变量、往对话里加或删消息。
EJS 模板按提示词模板插件补齐：setvar 写的变量会保存，条目开头的 @@if 等装饰器生效，显示正则里的 <%= getvar(…) %> 会显示成那一楼的数值；检测「提示词模板」的卡会看到它开着。

en.title: Card UIs can do more
en.text:
UIs built for Tavern Helper (start pages, battles, mini games) can now call the model (each card asks you first), read and write lorebooks (for this chat only), keep chat variables, and add or remove messages.
EJS templates follow the Prompt Template plugin more fully: setvar writes are kept, decorators such as @@if work, and <%= getvar(…) %> in a display regex shows that message's value; cards that check for Prompt Template find it.

zh.title: 错误日志和角色名册
zh.text:
出了问题时，「设置 → 更多 → 错误日志」（出错的提示条上也有）可以复制或存下一份报告发给开发者，里面没有对话内容，密钥、令牌和用户名都去掉了，只存在你自己的设备上。
角色名册人多时更好找：收成一行一个、可以搜索；「从对话里补充」认得外号和写错的名字。卡里自带的世界书可以导出或抽成单独的一本。

en.title: An error log, and the cast list
en.text:
When something goes wrong, Settings → More → Error log (also on the error's notice) copies or saves a report to send to the developer: no chat text, with keys, tokens and your user name taken out, and it stays on your device.
The cast list is easier with many characters: one row each, with search; Add from the chat knows nicknames and misspelled names. A card's own lorebook can be exported or copied out as a book of its own.

zh.title: 联网搜索
zh.text:
输入框左边多了一个地球图标，按对话开关。打开后，需要时事、真实地点和人物、作品资料这类现实世界的信息时，模型先搜网页再写，正文里不提搜索；回复下面可以展开看搜了什么、引用了哪些网页。
用供应商自己的搜索：Anthropic 接口的 Claude、OpenAI Responses 接口、OpenRouter 的模型可以用，搜索按次另外收费。

en.title: Web search
en.text:
A globe left of the input box turns web search on for a chat. When real-world facts are needed (news, real places and people, details of a work), the model searches first and keeps the search out of the story; what it searched for and the pages it cited unfold under the reply.
It uses the provider's own search: Claude on the Anthropic interface, the OpenAI Responses interface and OpenRouter models have it. Searches cost extra.

zh.title: 卡片界面连不上自己的接口时
zh.text: 有的大型卡在界面里自带 API 设置（比如角色创建界面），浏览器直接连你填的地址时常出现「Failed to fetch」。现在连不上时会问一次：改由 CicaTavern 替它连接吗？同意后这张卡连这个地址就经应用发出，走应用的网络代理，流式回复照样逐字到达。

en.title: When a card UI cannot reach its own API
en.text: Some big cards have their own API settings in their UI (a character creator, say), and the browser calling the address you typed often ends in "Failed to fetch". Now, when that happens, the app asks once whether CicaTavern should make the call for it; once you agree, that card reaches that address through the app and its network proxy, and streamed replies still arrive as they are written.

zh.title: 屏蔽词
zh.text:
「设置 → 写作 → 屏蔽词」，一份列表管所有对话。每个词可以去掉、遮成 * 或换成你自选的词，可以只改显示、只改发给模型的，或者两个都改；「更多」里有区分大小写、整词和例外。
存下来的原文不变，关掉或删掉就恢复；同一份列表每轮发出的内容一样，照常命中缓存。下面有试一试的框，拿当前对话的最新回复看换完的样子。

en.title: Blocked words
en.text:
Settings → Writing → Blocked words: one list for every chat. Each word can be removed, masked with * or swapped for one you choose, in what is shown, what is sent to the model, or both; More has case, whole words and exceptions.
The stored text never changes, so switching a word off or deleting it brings it back, and the same list sends the same text every turn, so the cache still hits. A try-it box below shows the open chat's latest reply with the list applied.

zh.title: 卡片界面权限
zh.text:
卡片界面（回复里卡片自带的网页界面）不经你点击、自己把输入框里的内容发出去，以前不会问；现在每张卡第一次这样做时问你一次。在卡片界面里点它的按钮发送算你自己发的，不用问。
自己调用模型、经 CicaTavern 联网也是每张卡问一次，现在「不允许」也会记住。想改的话，在角色卡菜单里点「卡片界面权限…」。

en.title: Card UI permissions
en.text:
A card's UI (the web page a card draws in its replies) could send what was in the input box without your click, and nothing asked; now each card asks the first time it does. Sending with one of its buttons is you sending, so that is never asked.
Calling the model and going online through CicaTavern also ask once per card, and now a no is kept as well. To change an answer, open Card UI permissions… in the card's menu.

zh.title: 更稳，也更像 SillyTavern
zh.text:
修了一批会让服务卡住或退出的情况（会无限回溯的正则、几千亿个骰子、能解压成几百 MB 的图片）和同时保存时互相覆盖、写坏文件的问题；安卓版重启后不再丢页面里存的东西（主题、卡片界面权限），网页崩了也能重新打开。
多条 initvar、正则里的 $0 和 {{match}}、预设里的 {{description}} 这类卡片字段，现在和 SillyTavern 读法一样。

en.title: Steadier, and closer to SillyTavern
en.text:
Fixed a set of ways the server could hang or quit (runaway regex, billions of dice, an image that inflates to hundreds of MB) and saves at the same time overwriting each other or breaking a file; the Android app keeps what its page saved (the theme, card UI permissions) across restarts and reopens after its web view crashes.
Several initvar entries, $0 and {{match}} in regex, and card fields such as {{description}} in presets now read as they do in SillyTavern.

zh.title: 语音输入
zh.text:
输入框右边多了一个麦克风：点一下开始说，再点一下转成文字，填进输入框，看过再自己发送。
不用安装任何东西：可以用供应商的转写接口（硅基流动 SenseVoice 免费），或电脑浏览器自带的识别；也能接自己装的 whisper 服务。在「配图与朗读 → 语音输入」里选，CicaTavern 不保存录音。

en.title: Voice input
en.text:
A microphone beside the input box: tap to speak, tap again and the words land in the box for you to read and send.
Nothing to install: a provider's transcription API (SiliconFlow's SenseVoice is free) or the desktop browser's own recognition, or a whisper server of your own. Choose in Pictures & voice → Voice input; CicaTavern keeps no recordings.

zh.title: 重画了也能换回来
zh.text:
配图、人设图、立绘和表情、场景图、卡的头像重画之后，旧的不丢：每处留最近几张，排在下面一行小图，点一张换回来用，不要的点 × 删掉。
留几张在「配图与朗读 → 画图方式」里改，默认 5 张。

en.title: Redraw, then take the old one back
en.text:
Illustrations, reference pictures, sprites and expressions, scenes and a card's avatar keep their last few versions after a redraw, in a row of thumbnails below: tap one to use it again, or × to delete it.
How many to keep is in Pictures & voice → Drawing (5 by default).

zh.title: 正则集、你的角色和文风，按卡指定
zh.text:
正则窗口改成和世界书一样，能复制、导出成 SillyTavern 的正则文件；还可以建自己的正则集，只挂到选中的几张卡上。
「你的角色」和「文风」变成列表，能复制、导入导出 SillyTavern 的格式，每张卡可以各指定一个，没指定的用默认的。

en.title: Regex sets, personas and styles, per card
en.text:
The regex window now works like the lorebook one, with copies and SillyTavern exports, and you can make regex sets that run only on the cards you attach them to.
Your personas and writing styles are lists with copies and SillyTavern imports and exports, and each card can pick one of each; the rest use the default.

zh.title: 1.9 加了什么
zh.text: 对话修改世界书、预设、正则和主题，自定义配色和正文字体；视觉小说的 HUD、换天、回忆和对白标注；卡片界面能调用模型、读写世界书，EJS 模板按提示词模板插件补齐；联网搜索、屏蔽词、错误日志，以及国内更新镜像。

en.title: What 1.9 added
en.text: Editing lorebooks, presets, regex and the theme by chat, custom colours and story fonts; the visual novel HUD, new days, memories and speaker marks; card UIs that call the model and edit lorebooks, and EJS templates that follow the Prompt Template plugin; web search, blocked words, an error log, and an update mirror in China.

zh.title: 上下文压缩，更自由也更省心
zh.text:
顶栏「压缩上下文」旁能看到这段对话用了多少上下文、离上限还有多远。到哪个比例整理成剧情存档、最多多少 token、是直接整理还是先提醒你，都在「设置 → 模型 → 上下文压缩」里按自己的习惯调；模型的上限会自动认出来，也可以自己填。
点「压缩上下文」时可以挑一个模型来写存档；故事太长、一个模型读不下时，会给出换模型或只保留最近两轮的办法，不会卡住。

en.title: Context compaction, your way
en.text:
Beside Compact context in the top bar you can see how much of the model's context a chat uses and how far it is from the limit. At what share it is turned into a story archive, the most tokens it may reach, and whether it compacts right away or reminds you first are all yours to set under Settings → Model → Context compaction; the model's limit is found for you, or you can enter it.
When you click Compact context you can pick the model that writes the archive, and a story too long for one model always has a way on: another model, or keeping only the last two turns.

zh.title: 立绘画得出来，也用得上了
zh.text:
画幅选竖幅就画竖幅：ComfyUI 工作流里写死了尺寸也照选的来，立绘和人设图站直了画，不再斜着挤在横图里。
卡上的 LoRA 和画风，视觉小说的立绘、人设图、表情也用上，和正文配图一个画风；在名册里换了人设图、改了长相，立绘这边马上跟着变。

en.title: Sprites you can actually use
en.text:
Pick portrait and you get portrait: even a ComfyUI workflow with its size written in follows the aspect you chose, so sprites and character pictures stand upright instead of leaning across a wide frame.
The card's LoRA and style now reach the visual novel's sprites, character pictures and expressions, matching the story's pictures; change someone's picture or looks in the cast list and their sprite follows at once.

zh.title: ComfyUI 出问题时说清楚
zh.text:
缺 LoRA 或文件、节点运行失败、显存不够、LoRA 和底模不是同一系列，都会直接告诉你原因，不再只是「画图失败」。
Flux、GGUF 这类只加载模型本体的工作流也能挂卡的 LoRA；排在别的任务后面时最多等一小时。另外，「更新了什么」改成从新到旧排。

en.title: ComfyUI says what went wrong
en.text:
A missing LoRA or file, a node that failed, running out of video memory, a LoRA from another model family: you are told why, not just "drawing failed".
Workflows that load only the diffusion model (Flux, GGUF) take the card's LoRA too, and a picture waiting behind other jobs gets an hour. Also, What's new now reads newest first.

zh.title: ComfyUI 选个模型就能画
zh.text:
画图方式选 ComfyUI 时多了「简单模式」：不用搭工作流、不用导出导入，点「读取模型」，从 ComfyUI 里装着的模型挑一个就能画。
Checkpoint（SD 1.5、SDXL、Illustrious）只选模型；Flux、Krea 2、Qwen-Image 这类扩散模型再选文本编码器和 VAE，编码器类型按文件名自动认。画幅、卡的 LoRA、立绘的设置都照样生效。

en.title: ComfyUI: pick a model and draw
en.text:
ComfyUI now has a simple mode: no workflow to build, export or import. Click Read models and pick one of the models your ComfyUI has.
A checkpoint (SD 1.5, SDXL, Illustrious) needs just the model; a diffusion model like Flux, Krea 2 or Qwen-Image also takes a text encoder and a VAE, with the encoder type worked out from the file name. Picture shape, the card's LoRA and the sprite settings all still apply.

zh.title: 导出的工作流直接能用
zh.text:
直接从 ComfyUI 导出、没写 %prompt% 的工作流，导入后也会顺着采样器找到提示词的位置，反向提示词和卡的 LoRA 也接得上。
宽高来自 Int 节点或 Resolution Selector 的工作流，选竖幅也真的画竖幅；尺寸由别的节点决定时，会告诉你该去改哪个节点。

en.title: Exported workflows just work
en.text:
A workflow exported straight from ComfyUI, with no %prompt% in it, now has its prompt found by following the samplers, and the negative and the card's LoRA go in too.
Workflows that take their size from Int nodes or a Resolution Selector draw portrait when you pick portrait; when another node decides the size, you are told which one to change.

zh.title: 立绘看得清，旧版本清得掉
zh.text:
视觉小说的「立绘」「场景」窗口里，立绘、表情和场景图点一下就放大；正在画什么、画了几秒、没画成的原因，都显示在窗口顶部，不会被窗口挡住。
应用内更新完成后，会问要不要清理旧版本的文件夹，也可以设成以后自动清理；数据目录不受影响。

en.title: Sprites up close, old versions cleared
en.text:
In the visual novel's Sprites and Scenes window, click a sprite, an expression or a scene to see it full size; what is being drawn, for how long, and why one failed now show at the top of the window instead of behind it.
After an in-app update you are asked whether to delete the old version's folders, and can have it done by itself from then on; your data folder is not touched.

zh.title: 创作角色卡，选得更细
zh.text:
开始前的「卡的设定」按类别分组、可以组合：一个或几个主角、重世界观、角色性别、玩法（好感、成长、经营、倒计时、探索，可多选）、纯文本卡或 MVU 卡、状态栏样式。没想好就点「给我灵感」或「交给 Cica」。
写卡在后台进行，有进度条，右下角小窗随时点回来。写完在打磨页拖动好感、天数这些数值，就能看到此时角色在哪个性格阶段、哪些事件会出现。

en.title: Card creation, with finer choices
en.text:
The card settings you pick before starting are grouped and can be combined: one or several leads, a rich world, the characters' gender, gameplay (bond, growth, management, countdown, exploration; pick any), a plain or MVU card, and the status bar style. Not sure yet? Try Give me ideas or Leave it to Cica.
Cards are written in the background with a progress bar, and a small window in the corner takes you back. When it is done, drag values like bond or days on the polish page to see which personality stage and which events apply.

zh.title: 做成视觉小说
zh.text:
创作角色卡的打磨页和每张卡的「⋯」菜单里多了「做成视觉小说」：开一个新对话进入视觉小说模式，先选这一批用什么画，再让辅助模型列出角色名册，画立绘、表情和背景，一步步来，画之前说清要画多少张。
新的「视觉小说预设」对白为主、旁白简明，更像 galgame；进入视觉小说模式时会问要不要改用。立绘取景也更稳：画成全身时只用头到大腿那一段。

en.title: Make it a visual novel
en.text:
The polish page and each card's ⋯ menu now have Make it a visual novel: a new chat in visual novel mode, then step by step you pick what to draw with, the helper model lists the cast, and sprites, expressions and backgrounds are drawn, with the count told before anything starts.
The new Visual novel preset is mostly dialogue with brief narration, more like a galgame, and is offered when you enter visual novel mode. Sprites are framed more reliably too: one drawn head to toe is shown from the thighs up.

zh.title: 上下文压缩只剩一个百分比
zh.text:
「上下文用到百分之几时压缩」，默认 70%，以前那个「最多几万 token」的上限去掉了。思考和联网中间的几次调用不再算进上下文，用量显示更准；角色卡和常驻世界书太大、压缩压不掉时会提醒你。
有的中转会把系统提示（角色卡、预设）整个丢掉，模型等于没看到卡：现在能发现，自动换一种方式重发。

en.title: Context compaction: just a percentage
en.text:
Compact at what percentage of the context, 70% by default; the old cap of so many thousand tokens is gone. Thinking and the calls in between a web search no longer count as context, so usage reads truer, and you are told when the card and constant lorebook entries are too big for compaction to help.
Some relays drop the system prompt (the card, the preset) entirely, so the model never sees the card: this is now noticed, and the request is sent again another way.

zh.title: 2.0 加了什么
zh.text: 语音输入、抽图历史（重画了也能换回来）、正则集和你的角色按卡指定；上下文压缩的用量条和设置；立绘画幅、画风和 LoRA 用到视觉小说；ComfyUI 简单模式，导出的工作流直接能用；应用内更新后清理旧版本，Mac 测试版有了 dmg。

en.title: What 2.0 added
en.text: Voice input, a drawing history (redraw and still go back), regex sets and your persona chosen per card; the context usage bar and compaction settings; sprite picture shape, style and LoRA used in the visual novel; ComfyUI simple mode, and exported workflows that just work; clearing old versions after an update, and a dmg for the Mac beta.

zh.title: 行动选项不再消失，还能单独换一组
zh.text:
以前旧回复的四个选项不发给模型，模型看历史里都没有，写着写着就不写了。现在选项留在历史里，每轮都会写（更新前的回复照旧，缓存不受影响）。
最新一条回复下面多了「换一组选项」：只重写结尾的四个选项，正文不动；这一轮没写选项时是「补写选项」。视觉小说模式里在「重新生成」旁边。

en.title: Choices stay, and can be redrawn alone
en.text:
Older replies used to reach the model without their four choices, so with none in the history it stopped writing them. Choices now stay in the history and come every turn (replies from before the update are sent as they were, so the cache still holds).
The newest reply has New choices: only the four choices at its end are rewritten, the story stays; a turn without them offers Write choices. In visual novel mode it sits beside Regenerate.

zh.title: 角色卡自己排，配图按你的写法
zh.text:
卡片「⋯」菜单里能「置顶」和「收藏」：置顶的排在最上面，搜索框旁的 ☆ 只看收藏的卡；按住卡片上下拖动，自己排顺序（手机上长按再拖）。电脑和手机看到的一样。
「配图与朗读」多了「画面提示词」一页，「画风与 LoRA」里有九种画风预设，选一个就换上对应的画风词。

en.title: Cards in your order, pictures your way
en.text:
A card's ⋯ menu can pin it or favorite it: pinned cards sit at the top, and the ☆ beside the search box shows only favorites. Drag cards up and down to put them in your own order (on a phone, press and hold first). The computer and the phone see the same list.
Pictures and voice has a new Picture prompts page, and Art style and LoRA has nine art style presets: pick one and its style words go in.

zh.title: 配图提示词：额外要求、详细程度
zh.text:
「写提示词的额外要求」是写给写提示词的模型看的规则，比如「多写光影和镜头」「不要出现血」；可以直接写，也可以读入别人分享的 .md / .txt 生图 skill。全局一份，每张卡还能再加自己的。
详细程度分简洁、标准、详细三档。默认写法也改好了：先定景别和镜头，不写角色名字；ComfyUI 和 SD WebUI 每张图都带上卡的画风。

en.title: Picture prompts: your rules, your level of detail
en.text:
Extra rules are read by the model that writes picture prompts, like "more light and camera work" or "no blood"; type them, or read in a .md / .txt image prompt skill someone shared. One set for every card, and each card can add its own.
Pick concise, standard or detailed. The default instructions are better too: shot and camera angle first, no character names; ComfyUI and SD WebUI put the card's art style in every picture.

zh.title: Vertex AI，和一些修复
zh.text:
模型供应商新增「Vertex AI」模板：用 Google Cloud 的 JSON 凭据，新账号的赠金能用在这里；繁忙时自动等几秒重试，最多 2 次。
MOSI 的 MOSS-Image 能画了；卡片「⋯」菜单里能直接导出角色卡；模型的内容审查拦下回复时，会说清是谁拦的、能怎么办；错误日志附上供应商的原始返回和最近的操作。

en.title: Vertex AI, and some fixes
en.text:
A new Vertex AI provider template takes a Google Cloud JSON credential, so a new account's free-trial credit can be used; when it is busy it waits a few seconds and tries again, twice at most.
MOSI's MOSS-Image draws; a card's ⋯ menu exports it straight away; when a model's content check stops a reply, you are told whose check it was and what to do; the error log keeps the provider's whole answer and your latest operations.

zh.title: 2.1 加了什么
zh.text: 创作角色卡的设定按类别组合，后台写卡，写完拖动数值看性格阶段和事件；做成视觉小说，一步步备齐名册、立绘、表情和背景，还有视觉小说预设；上下文压缩只剩一个百分比；行动选项留在历史里，最新一条能「换一组选项」。

en.title: What 2.1 added
en.text: Card creation settings combined by category, cards written in the background, and values dragged afterwards to see personality stages and events; Make it a visual novel, with the cast, sprites, expressions and backgrounds prepared step by step, and a visual novel preset; context compaction as one percentage; choices kept in the history, with New choices on the newest reply.

zh.title: 旧手机上的两个问题修好了
zh.text: 有些安卓手机的系统 WebView 版本较旧，在上面「创作角色卡」的页面划不动，提示条报「dialog:modal is not a valid selector」后一直挂着不消失。现在两处都改好了，旧 WebView 上也能正常滚动、提示到时间自己消失。

en.title: Two problems on older phones, fixed
en.text: On Android phones with an older system WebView, the Create a card page would not scroll, and a toast saying "dialog:modal is not a valid selector" stayed on screen for good. Both are fixed: the page scrolls and toasts go away on time there too.

zh.title: Gemini Agent Platform 能用 API Key 了
zh.text: 「Gemini Agent Platform」（原 Vertex AI）模板现在可以直接粘贴 Agent Platform 的 API Key，不用再弄 JSON 凭据，Google Cloud 新账号的赠金照样能用；「从接口获取模型列表」会把常见的 Gemini 模型逐个试一遍（不花钱），列出你的项目能用的。另外，连不上供应商时不再只显示「aborted」，会说是超时、提示检查网络和代理。

en.title: Gemini Agent Platform takes an API key
en.text: The Gemini Agent Platform template (formerly Vertex AI) now takes an Agent Platform API key pasted straight in, no JSON credential needed, and a new Google Cloud account's credit still works; Fetch model list tries the common Gemini models one by one (free) and lists the ones your project can use. Also, a provider that cannot be reached no longer just says "aborted": it says it timed out and to check the network and proxy.

zh.title: 能看模型的思考过程了
zh.text: 「设置 → 模型」里打开「显示模型的思考过程」，GLM、DeepSeek、Kimi、Claude 等模型的思考会折叠显示在回复上方，生成时可以展开看；Gemini 和 OpenAI 打开后也会去要一份思考摘要。只是显示，不会发回给模型。模型写在正文里的 <thinking>、<思考>、<思维链>、<CoT> 也改成折叠，点开就能看。

en.title: See the model think
en.text: Turn on Show the model's thinking in Settings → Model: the thinking of GLM, DeepSeek, Kimi, Claude and others shows folded above each reply, and you can open it while the reply is written; Gemini and OpenAI are asked for a summary of theirs. It is only shown, never sent back to the model. Reasoning a model writes in the story itself (<thinking>, <CoT>, and the same tags in Chinese) folds too, a tap away.

zh.title: 手机和电脑一起开着，两边自动同步
zh.text: 用手机连电脑玩的时候，手机上发的一轮，电脑上的页面马上显示「正在生成」，写完自动出现，不用再关掉重开；反过来也一样。改标题、导入角色卡这些也会同步过去。

en.title: Phone and computer stay in step
en.text: Playing from a phone connected to the computer, a turn sent on the phone shows as being written on the computer at once and appears when it is done, with no closing and reopening; the other way round too. Renamed chats and imported cards follow as well.

zh.title: 复制消息，选项可以多选
zh.text:
每条消息下面多了「复制」：复制显示出来的文字，不带名字和按钮；回复还可以只复制正文、状态或选项。手机上长按选字也不会再把顶栏、轮数和输入框选进去。
行动选项点一下是加进输入框，可以点好几个一起发，再点一次去掉；卡写了五个以上选项也都显示出来。

en.title: Copy a message; pick several options
en.text:
Every message has Copy: its text as shown, without the name or buttons; for a reply, all of it or only the story, the status or the options. Selecting by long press on a phone no longer takes in the top bar, the round or the input box.
Tapping an option now adds it to the input box, so several can go together (tap again to take it out), and cards with more than four options show them all.

zh.title: 拖卡更顺手，分组也能排
zh.text:
拖动角色卡时旁边的卡会平滑让开，手机上长按后卡片浮起来跟着手指走。分组标题也能拖，整组一起换位置。电脑上把卡拖到桌面或文件夹里松开，就直接导出成文件。
「创作角色卡」保存的卡会写上作者：你的名字 + CicaTavern。

en.title: Smoother dragging; groups in your order
en.text:
Dragging a card, the others slide out of its way; on a phone it lifts after a long press and follows your finger. Group titles drag too, taking their cards along. On a computer, drop a card on the desktop or a folder and it is exported there as a file.
Cards saved from Create a card carry an author: your name + CicaTavern.

zh.title: 长期记忆（Beta），还能隐藏一轮
zh.text:
设置 → 模型 → 长期记忆（Beta）打开后，压缩上下文时会把人物、事件、物品与地点、约定与伏笔记进这个对话的「记忆簿」；之后哪一轮提到它们，就把相关的几条附在这一轮发给模型，回复下面写着「想起：…」。顶栏「记忆」可以查看、修改、固定；也可以开「边玩边整理」，每隔几轮在后台记一次。
回复下面多了「隐藏这一轮」：这一轮留在对话里，但不再发给模型。某一轮让内容审查一直拦着后面的请求时，隐藏它就能接着玩。

en.title: Long-term memory (Beta), and hiding a round
en.text:
Turn on Settings → Model → Long-term memory (Beta), and compacting the context also writes the people, events, things and places, and promises and foreshadowing into the chat's memory book; when a later round mentions them, the matching entries go along with that round, and the reply says Recalled: …. Open Memory in the top bar to read, edit or pin them, or switch on Tidy while playing to note things down every few rounds.
Replies have Hide this round: the round stays in the chat but is no longer sent to the model. When one round keeps a content check refusing everything after it, hide it and play on.

zh.title: 对话修改改卡更靠谱
zh.text:
模型说「改好了」却没写出改动时，向导会追问一次；还是没有，就说清原因，可以「再问一次」。让它「改成 MVU 卡」时，会建好初始变量和更新规则，进行中的对话「应用到当前对话」后也补上变量。
另外：有些卡的开场界面报错「Cannot read properties of undefined」修好了；从这一版起，CicaTavern 的许可证改为 AGPL-3.0，自己使用不受影响。

en.title: Changing a card by talking, more dependable
en.text:
When the model says it made changes but wrote none out, it is asked once more; still nothing, and you are told why and can ask again. Asked to make a card an MVU card, it sets up the initial variables and the update rules, and a chat under way gets the variables when you apply the change to it.
Also: the error some cards' opening screens showed (Cannot read properties of undefined) is fixed, and from this version CicaTavern is licensed under the AGPL-3.0; using it yourself is not affected.

zh.title: 2.2 加了什么
zh.text: 角色卡置顶、收藏、拖动排序，分组也能排，电脑上能把卡拖出窗口导出；配图提示词可以自己定写法和画风预设；Gemini Agent Platform；显示模型的思考过程；手机和电脑自动同步；消息可以复制，行动选项可以多选。

en.title: What 2.2 added
en.text: Cards pinned, favorited and dragged into your own order, groups too, and dragged out of the window to export; picture prompts written your way, with art style presets; Gemini Agent Platform; the model's thinking shown; phone and computer kept in sync; messages copied, and several choices picked at once.

zh.title: 长对话不卡了，刻度条也不挤
zh.text:
两三百轮的对话，模型一边写、页面一边重排的开销降到几乎为零，打开长对话也快了好几倍。
正文右边的刻度条只把你正在看的十轮左右铺开，更早和更晚的收进两头的细纹带里；往上翻时上面的刻度一路展开，拖动也能一直拖到第一轮。手机上对话的删除按钮、角色卡的 ⋯ 现在都看得见了。

en.title: Long chats stay smooth, and the rail stays readable
en.text:
In a chat of two or three hundred rounds, laying out the page while a reply streams in now costs next to nothing, and long chats open several times faster.
The rail beside the story spreads out only the ten or so rounds you are reading; earlier and later ones fold into a band at each end, unfolding as you scroll, and a drag still reaches the first round. On a phone, the delete button of a chat and the ⋯ of a card now show.

zh.title: 卡片界面能用更多酒馆命令
zh.text:
卡片界面发的 SillyTavern 命令（/setvar、/if、/sys、/gen、/buttons 等几十个，带管道和闭包）现在都能跑；这里没有的命令跳过那一步、其余照常，并提示一次。开局页「/sys 开局信息 | /trigger」这类写法能正常开始剧情了。
另外：Base URL 中间多打了空格时会自动去掉。

en.title: Card interfaces run more SillyTavern commands
en.text:
The SillyTavern commands a card interface sends (dozens of them, like /setvar, /if, /sys, /gen and /buttons, with pipes and closures) now run; a command this app lacks skips that step, the rest runs, and you are told once. Opening screens that start the story with /sys and /trigger work now.
Also: spaces typed inside a Base URL are taken out.

zh.title: 正文不再往回弹，打开就是上次聊的
zh.text:
上一版切换对话、写完新回合后，正文会停在最新几轮之前，这一版修好了：现在都会停在最底部。划动换版本、改消息时也留在原来那一行。
打开应用时进的是最近聊过的那段对话，不再是一张说不清的卡。

en.title: The story stays put, and you start where you left off
en.text:
In the last version, switching chats or finishing a new turn could leave you a few rounds above the latest one. That is fixed: you land at the very bottom, and swiping or editing a message keeps you on the same line.
The app now opens on the chat you last played, not on some card you can't place.

zh.title: Gemini 原生接口、MOSS 朗读、安卓导出
zh.text:
供应商多了「Gemini 原生」接口，和 SillyTavern 选 Google AI Studio 时走的是同一个，「Gemini API」模板默认用它。朗读来源加了国内直连的 MOSS。
安卓应用能把对话包和角色卡 PNG 存进「下载」文件夹了。报错也说得更清楚：模型繁忙、被限流、额度用完各写各的，并说明是不是你这边的问题。

en.title: Native Gemini, MOSS voices, exports on Android
en.text:
Providers can now use the native Gemini API, the same one SillyTavern uses for Google AI Studio, and the Gemini API template starts on it. MOSS joins the voice sources.
The Android app saves chat packages and card PNGs to Downloads. Errors are clearer too: a busy model, a rate limit and a used-up quota each say so, and say whether the trouble is on your side.

zh.title: 回合制战斗
zh.text:
角色卡的「⋯」里多了「游戏规则…」（开发中），按卡开启，默认关，关着时发给模型的内容不变。
规则开到「完整」，模型写到打起来就进入战斗：攻击、技能、道具、防御、逃跑，成败由程序算，模型只管把结果写好。打赢得经验，升级加属性；遇到新敌人会记进图鉴，可以画立绘。

en.title: Turn-based fights
en.text:
A card's ⋯ menu has Game rules (in development), on per card and off by default; off, nothing sent to the model changes.
With the rules at Full, a fight starts when the story comes to blows: attack, skills, items, guard or flee. The program decides the outcome and the model writes it. Wins bring experience and levels, and new foes go into a bestiary, with pictures if you like.

zh.title: 掷骰检定和行囊
zh.text:
有风险的选项会写明属性、成功率和风险，点了就掷骰，结果随这一轮发给模型。点数由种子决定，重新生成、回滚、读档都不变。
「行囊」里有角色、背包、任务、地图和成就。物品可以使用，卡已有的体力、背包、任务变量也能绑定成规则的字段。

en.title: Dice checks and the pack
en.text:
A risky choice shows its attribute, odds and risk. Pick it and the dice roll, and the result goes to the model with the turn. Rolls come from a seed, so regenerating, rolling back or loading a save changes nothing.
The pack holds your character, items, quests, a map and achievements. Items can be used, and a card's own health, inventory and quest variables can be bound to the rules.

zh.title: 视觉小说有了四种界面
zh.text:
右上角「界面」→「主题」换整体样子：简约、古风、怀旧游戏机、酷炫，战斗和掷骰跟着一起换。
选项挪到了对话框上方，不再挡住立绘的脸。写行动时画面也不再跳动。

en.title: Four looks for the visual novel
en.text:
View → Theme at the top right changes the whole look: Simple, Classical, Retro console or Bold, with fights and dice to match.
The choices now sit above the text box and stay off the sprite's face, and writing an action no longer moves the picture.

zh.title: 每种主题都有自己的战斗
zh.text:
主题不只是换颜色。古风掷的是一圈八卦，放技能是大字泼墨；怀旧游戏机是老式窗口，动作一格一格跳；酷炫用纯色切割和技能横幅。
简约跟着应用的浅色和深色走。选项、掷骰、战斗、放技能、胜利都跟着换。

en.title: Every theme has its own fights
en.text:
A theme is more than colours. Classical rolls on a ring of trigrams and writes skills in big ink strokes; Retro console uses old-style windows with moves that jump frame by frame; Bold cuts in solid colour with skill banners.
Simple follows the app's light or dark. Choices, dice, fights, skills and victory all change with it.

zh.title: 直连对话
zh.text:
不用角色卡也能直接和模型聊，入口在左栏角色卡列表最上面。不带角色扮演的规矩，就是一个普通的助手。
可以附文本文件，也能联网搜索；回复按 Markdown 显示，列表、表格、代码都排得好。

en.title: Direct chat
en.text:
Talk to a model with no character card, from the top of the card list. No roleplay rules come with it: it is a plain assistant.
Attach text files or search the web. Replies show as Markdown, with lists, tables and code laid out properly.

zh.title: 创作角色卡能做的多了
zh.text:
「卡的设定」下面多了折叠的「高级选项」，不选就和以前一样：背包和册子、写前自查、随机事件、裁判表、世界动态、建角页。卡的规模分轻量、标准、大作，大作最多 60 个角色。
还能附参考文件，txt、md、设定、别的卡都行；状态栏多了水墨、羊皮卷等样式。

en.title: More in the card creator
en.text:
Advanced options now fold out under the card's setting, and nothing changes if you leave them: bags and books, a self-check before writing, random events, a judge table, world moves and a character page. Cards come in light, standard and epic sizes, up to 60 characters.
You can attach reference files too, from text and notes to other cards, and the status bar gained new styles such as ink and parchment.

zh.title: 检查这张卡
zh.text:
角色卡的「⋯」和修改角色卡里多了「检查这张卡」，自己做的卡和导入的卡都能查：写错的正则和模板、连成一个的关键词、永远发送不了的条目、状态栏对不上变量。
程序查不花钱，每一条都看得到改前改后，可以采用或撤销。想听建议再点「让模型再看看」。

en.title: Check this card
en.text:
The card's ⋯ menu and the card editor now have Check this card, for your own cards and imported ones: broken regexes and templates, keywords run together, entries that can never be sent, a status bar that doesn't match its variables.
The program's check costs nothing. Every item shows before and after, and can be taken or undone. Choose Ask a model only if you want its suggestions.

zh.title: 试玩体检
zh.text:
角色卡的「⋯」里多了「试玩体检」：一个模型扮卡，一个模型扮玩家，中途还会故意试探，比如硬闯、说假话、让它替你决定。
玩完程序统计变量和格式写对了多少，再由模型挑出抢话、矛盾、放水和重复。点了才发送，开始前会写大约花多少。

en.title: Trial run
en.text:
The card's ⋯ menu has Trial run: one model plays the card and another plays you, testing it on purpose by forcing their way, telling lies or asking it to decide for them.
Afterwards the program counts how well variables and formats held up, and a model picks out speaking for the player, contradictions, going easy and repetition. Nothing is sent until you start, and it tells you about how much first.

zh.title: 文风全部重写
zh.text:
基础预设的文风重写了一遍，每种都有自己的硬要求，读起来分得开。新加了文艺、日记、写实、淡然和烟火气，「白描」去掉了，选过的自动换成「淡然」。
鼠标停在按钮上能看说明和示例，手机上点一下。

en.title: Writing styles rewritten
en.text:
The Basic preset's writing styles are all new, each with rules of its own, so they read apart. Literary, Diary, Realist, Understated and Earthy are added. One old style is gone, and anyone who chose it moves to Understated.
Rest the mouse on a button to read its note and a sample, or tap it on a phone.

zh.title: 还有这些
zh.text:
每条消息都能单独删除，模型之后不再看到。手机访问有了二维码，设置可以搜索。左右栏能收起，正文能拖宽。
跳到前面的对话再往上翻不再瞬移，CG 回廊关掉图片回到回廊，模型下拉框修好了，手机后台掐断回复时会告诉你怎么设置。

en.title: And also
en.text:
Any single message can be deleted, and the model stops seeing it. Phone access has a QR code, settings can be searched, the side columns fold away and the story column drags wider.
Going up after a jump no longer throws you elsewhere, closing a picture returns to the CG gallery, the model list opens again, and a reply cut off in the background tells you what to set on your phone.

zh.title: 2.3 加了什么
zh.text: 长期记忆（Beta）：压缩掉的剧情，提到时会想起来；隐藏这一轮；两三百轮的长对话不卡了；卡片界面能用更多 SillyTavern 命令；Gemini 原生接口和 MOSS 朗读；安卓能导出对话包和角色卡 PNG。

en.title: What 2.3 added
en.text: Long-term memory (Beta), so compacted story comes back when it is mentioned; hiding a round from the model; chats of hundreds of rounds staying smooth; more SillyTavern commands in card interfaces; native Gemini and MOSS voices; chat packages and card PNGs exported on Android.

zh.title: 聊着天随手调
zh.text:
顶栏模型旁边多了「思考」，每个对话单独选默认、关或 low 到 max，下一条回复起生效，不改动设置和供应商。
基础预设能填正文字数范围，模型在范围里定长短；主题里多了行距。顶栏「记忆」点开就能开关长期记忆，「世界书」标出这张卡自带和在用的书。

en.title: Tune it as you chat
en.text:
A Thinking pick sits beside the model in the top bar: default, off or low to max, per chat and from the next reply, leaving the settings and the provider as they are.
The basic preset takes a story length range, and the theme has line spacing. Memory in the top bar turns long-term memory on or off, and World books marks the books the card brings and uses.

zh.title: 检查、试玩和创作向导
zh.text:
检查这张卡多了「调整状态栏」和大卡的「全本检查」，试玩发现的问题能进检查列表一键修；试玩还会查数值和按数值触发的事件。
创作向导能选你在卡里的性别，审稿对照方案，事件只发生一次，某一步写坏了可以换个模型重写。回复写到一半断了，已写的内容也会留下。

en.title: Checks, trial runs and the card creator
en.text:
Check this card adds Adjust status bar and, for big cards, Check the whole card; problems a trial run finds go into the check list to fix. Trial runs also check values and the events they set off.
The card creator asks your gender in the card, reviews against the plan, keeps one-time events one-time, and can redo a failed step with another model. A reply cut off partway keeps what was written.

zh.title: 画 CG 和 Codex 画图
zh.text:
视觉小说控制栏多了「画 CG」，给眼前这一幕画一张；「配图」里能关掉立绘，或者选几个常驻角色一直站在台上。
电脑版的画图方式可以选「Codex（本机）」，用你自己装好登录的 Codex CLI 画，下面有安装和登录的说明。

en.title: Draw a CG, draw with Codex
en.text:
The visual novel controls add Draw CG for the scene in front of you, and Pictures lets you hide sprites or keep a few characters on stage.
On a computer, the drawing method can be Codex (this PC): the Codex CLI you installed and signed in to yourself, with setup steps right below it.

zh.title: 队伍战斗
zh.text:
开了「完整」游戏规则的卡，可以带同伴一起打，最多 4 人上场，像 RPG Maker 那样每回合给每个人选指令，敌我按速度出手。每个同伴有自己的属性、生命、技能、等级和经验，回血和药能给别人，倒下的人能救起来。
行囊里的「队伍」页安排谁出战、谁待命；规则窗口的「队伍名册」写同伴和他们的技能。故事里有人入队、离队、负伤，模型会记下来。

en.title: Party fights
en.text:
On a card with the full game rules, companions fight beside you, up to four in all: each round you give everyone a command, as in an RPG Maker game, and both sides act by speed. Each companion has their own attributes, life, skills, level and experience; healing and potions can go to someone else, and the fallen can be revived.
The Party tab in the pack says who fights and who stands by; Party roster in the rule window lists the companions and their skills. When someone joins, leaves or is hurt in the story, the model records it.

zh.title: 每张卡自己的叫法，出字效果
zh.text:
游戏规则多了「叫法」：属性、生命、敌人档位、技能、行囊、经验、队伍都能按卡改名，比如力量、HP、BOSS、必杀技、伙伴，界面和发给模型的规则一起换。「题材」多了怪兽养成、网游、末日求生、日常。
主题里多了「出字效果」：回复按均匀的节奏写出来，可以选淡入、墨晕、打字机、逐句或直接显示。

en.title: A card's own words, and how replies appear
en.text:
The game rules gain Names: attributes, life, foe tiers, skills, the pack, experience and the party can each take the card's own name, such as Strength, HP, BOSS or Special move, in the interface and in the rules the model is told. Genre now offers Monster raising, Online game, Apocalypse survival and Everyday life.
The theme gains Text reveal: a reply comes out at an even pace, as Fade in, Ink, Typewriter, By sentence or Instant.

zh.title: 长对话不再越聊越卡
zh.text:
几百轮的对话，切换角色卡、打开对话从一秒多降到一百毫秒左右，点发送和逐字写出也不再卡一下；手机上快得更明显。
还卡的话，打开「设置 → 更多 → 性能记录」，它会记下每一步花了多久，可以复制下来发给开发者。默认关着，不影响速度。

en.title: Long chats stay quick
en.text:
In a chat hundreds of turns long, switching cards or opening the chat now takes about a tenth of a second instead of more than one, and sending and replies being written no longer stall; the gain is larger on phones.
If it still feels slow, turn on Settings > More > Performance log: it records how long each step took, to copy and send to the developer. It is off by default and costs nothing while off.
